email.subject: DPA draft for the clienteling expansion — ahead of procurement
email.body:
Hi Karim,

Margaux's team is expanding the clienteling pilot to the EU boutiques, and the data processing terms will land on your desk via procurement soon.

To save you a cycle, here is our DPA draft aligned with the EU data-transfer framework — I noticed your recent note on the topic and matched its structure.

Happy to walk through it in 15 minutes this week.

Best,
Alex
